name: veil
description: A privacy layer between your app and any third-party LLM. Pseudonymizes emails, paths, URLs, IPs deterministically before the wire.
author: Ahmet Barış Günaydın <hi@barisgunaydin.com>

scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run build:rust
scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:rust
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspace=@abgnydn/veil && cd rust && cargo clean
